dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Made any discoveries?

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: I was reading up on some of Mondstadt's historical myths previously. Fortunately, the library has a wealth of resources for reference.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Of all the myths and legends in Mondstadt, the one I'm most fascinated by has to be The Legend of Vennessa.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: The spirit of freedom prized by Mondstadt must have been modeled after her courage in standing up to injustice and oppressive rulers. Even as an outsider, I am deeply moved.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: My focus has shifted to the songs of Mondstadt of late, so I'm done with this book now. Just remember to return it to the library once you've finished reading it...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Hello, my friend. You want to talk?

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Sayid, a visiting scholar from Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Mondstadt is a pleasant place. I have been here for some time now, and I am reluctant to leave... It has definitely brought out my more, ahem, leisurely side...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: In all seriousness though, a leisurely lifestyle just means doing whatever makes you happy, doesn't it? A fitting ethos for the City of Freedom...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: And it seems that I've become a total convert without anyone having to preach it from the rooftops... Hah. The remarkable wisdom of the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Anemo Archon Barbatos, my respect to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: It's my homeland, though I haven't been back in a long while.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Sumeru is known all over the world as a center of learning. As a traveler, I'm sure you must have heard of the Sumeru Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Ms. Lisa of the Knights of Favonius studied there. My teacher mentioned her once — allegedly, Lisa was the best student they'd seen in two hundred years...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: I am exceptionally curious as to the real reason that she wound up working here as a librarian...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Farewell, may you forever grow in wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Stormterror's story... Or should I say, Dvalin's, is a topic with great research value.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: I never expected to encounter such a cataclysmic event on my trip to Mondstadt. For me, it's quite fortunate.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Anyway, I will record everything I have seen and heard. I should like for my compatriots in Sumeru to learn of these historical events...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Stormterror's story... Or should I say, Dvalin's, is a topic with great research value.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: I never expected to encounter such a cataclysmic event on my trip to Mondstadt. For me, it's quite fortunate.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Anyway, I will record everything I have seen and heard. I should like for my compatriots in Sumeru to learn of these historical events...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: ...Oh, my apologies. Did my musings disturb you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: I'm currently reading the works of some bards.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: They weave their ideas, thoughts, and truths into romantic poetry, not at all like the unwieldy tomes of Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Perhaps this romanticism is an expression of great wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Yes, this is excellent. Excellent material, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Farewell.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Farewell. May you grow in wisdom.
